examples.description: Record a payment against an invoice (integer CENTS: $350.00 → 35000)
Record by invoice number with a decimal-string amount

failure_modes.recovery: do exactly what the error says — every refusal hands you the exact resend literals to copy.
failure_modes.when: the amount is a bare ambiguous number (dollars or cents?), exceeds the remaining balance without allow_overpayment, names a different currency than the invoice, or the invoice is cancelled

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_list and retry with an id from the list.
failure_modes.when: invoice_id / invoice_number does not name an invoice in your tenant

preconditions: Money is integer CENTS ($15.00 → 1500) via amount_cents, or a decimal STRING via amount ("1500.00") — the server parses; never convert units yourself.

The invoice may be named by invoice_id or invoice_number. Draft invoices are payable (the door auto-advances draft→sent); cancelled invoices refuse; over-payment refuses unless allow_overpayment is true.

status 'paid' derives from the ledger: at least one payment, and payments plus credit notes/discounts ≥ total (a write-off never counts) — this door is how an invoice becomes paid; never call invoice_update with status 'paid'.

description: Records a money-in fact row against an invoice (by invoice_id or its invoice_number) in ONE call: money is integer CENTS via amount_cents, or a decimal STRING via amount — never multiply or divide yourself. A draft invoice auto-advances to 'sent'; a cancelled invoice refuses; an amount above the remaining balance refuses unless allow_overpayment is true. status 'paid' derives from the ledger this writes, so this is how an invoice becomes paid. A same invoice/amount/day repeat refuses as a likely duplicate unless resent with force:true. NEXT: invoice_read to read it back.

allow_overpayment.description: Explicit override (default false): record more than the remaining balance / pay an already-settled invoice.

amount.description: Money as a decimal STRING ("1500.00" = $1,500.00), parsed server-side. Use amount_cents for integer CENTS instead — never convert units yourself.

force.description: Confirms a genuine second payment when the same invoice/amount/day already has one recorded (default false refuses it as a likely duplicate) — resend the SAME call with force:true.

invoice_number.description: Alias of invoice_id — the invoice's own number (tenant-unique), resolved server-side.

name: invoice_payment_record
